risks.note: The technology industry sees intense competition from domestic and global players across software services, digital transformation, e-Governance, cloud computing, AI and managed services; sustained innovation, service quality, execution capability and cost efficiency are critical to maintaining market position.

Strong sector-wide demand for skilled professionals in AI, cloud, cybersecurity, data analytics and digital engineering makes availability/retention of qualified talent a key challenge that may push up employee costs.

The accelerating pace of technological advancement raises the risk of technology obsolescence; competitiveness depends on continuously upgrading capabilities and aligning offerings with evolving customer requirements and industry trends.

A part of revenue is derived from overseas operations and international clients (including US execution facilities), so fluctuations in the Rupee against major global currencies may impact revenue, margins and competitiveness.

The business is influenced by Government policies on IT, digital governance, education, taxation and public procurement; changes in laws, Government spending priorities, fiscal incentives or policy frameworks (Central or State) could affect operations and growth. The generic risk list flagged in the MD&A also cites political instability and legal-framework risk.

Client concentration is explicitly flagged among the risks and concerns continuously monitored by the Board and senior management, given the Company's reliance on large Government/institutional counterparties for its ICT and e-Governance project revenue.
The Company flags time- and cost-overruns on fixed-price contracts as a monitored risk, relevant given its multi-year, fixed-value Government ICT/school-infrastructure project contracts.

sk.overview: The company is positioned in the modular exhibition stands industry serving the Meetings, Incentives, Conferences & Exhibitions (MICE) sector in India. Modular exhibition stands are flexible and reusable display structures used by businesses to showcase their brands, products and services at trade fairs, exhibitions, conferences, expos and promotional events. Unlike traditional custom-built stands that are typically designed for one-time use, modular stands are made from prefabricated components that can be assembled, dismantled and reconfigured multiple times based on event requirements.
